name: app-dark-nav-pills-with-lime-expanding-active-item-states
title: Expanding Lime Active Nav Pill States
whatItIs: Four stacked dark navigation bars, each with four circular icon buttons where a different one is active as a lime circle expanded into a pill with a label (Home, Portfolio, Watchlist, Markets), showing the sequence of an animated tab change.
whatItMeans: Showing each state stacked reveals how the bar behaves, and lime on charcoal is crisp and financial.
techniques: Active item expands into a labelled pill
Lime and black for the active button
States stacked vertically to show progression

vocabulary.definition: A tab that grows to show its label when selected.
Several frames showing each state of a component.
